identity.trajectoryEquation: Small Daily Actions → Habits → Consistency → Progress → Becoming

creator.name: Brian Omuse
creator.bio: Brian Omuse is the creator and founder of CRESCIVE. A teenage creator and digital innovator from Malaba, Kenya, he founded CRESCIVE in 2026 to provide individuals worldwide with a structured personal growth and self-development platform.
creator.attributionStatement: CRESCIVE was created, developed, and founded in 2026 by Brian Omuse in Malaba, Kenya.

purpose.summary: CRESCIVE is a personal growth and self-development platform designed to help people become who they strive to be through consistent daily action, deep focus, balanced life dimension mapping, intelligent navigation, and genuine social connection.
purpose.keyDistinctionFromHabitTrackers: Unlike basic checklist or habit tracking apps that simply record binary yes/no streaks, CRESCIVE connects identity to trajectory. It links a user's core values, 5-year vision, and chosen life dimensions directly to discrete daily Moves, deep work focus sessions, intelligent navigation, real member connections, and playful recharge breaks.

home.name: Home
home.purpose: Daily dashboard providing an immediate, unified view of daily momentum, active moves, challenges, and global standing.
implementedFeatures: Daily Momentum meter summarizing active execution state
Daily Challenge card with prompt, XP rewards, and streak tracking
Upcoming scheduled Moves with direct completion toggles
Quick Category Jump Links across life domains
Home Leaderboard preview showing verified rank and distance to next peer
Creator Story modal access ('Brian's Story')
Help & How to Use the App walkthrough guide access

moves.name: Moves
moves.purpose: The core action engine of CRESCIVE where ambitions are translated into discrete, manageable actions.
implementedFeatures: Creation of custom Moves with title, category domain, and notes
Time commitments (5 min, 10 min, 20 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 2+ hours)
Repeat schedules (None, Daily, Weekdays, Weekly)
Real-time scheduled alarms, sound chimes, and browser notifications
Active Reminder Alarm modal with snooze, time adjust, and start in sanctuary options
One-tap completion toggles granting verified +25 XP
Deep Work Sanctuary launch button for active Moves
Curated Move Ideas catalog across all life categories

fun.name: Fun Zone
fun.purpose: A lighter, playful environment integrated directly into the growth journey to recharge mental energy without abandoning momentum.
implementedFeatures: Interactive 3D mini-games including Cosmic Orbit and Precision Tap
Mental agility challenges: Memory Match, Reaction Speed Test, Quick Math Sprint, Word Scramble
Curated humor vault: Tech jokes, Student Life, Dad Jokes, Smart/Funny, Silly Jokes
Daily Creative Sparks, thought-provoking questions, and riddles
Playful XP earnings ensuring recharge periods still advance profile progress

fifteenMap.name: 15 Map (Life Dimensions)
fifteenMap.purpose: Comprehensive developmental map categorizing human potential across 15 balanced life domains.
implementedFeatures: 15 holistic dimensions: Personal Growth, Career & Ambition, Financial Freedom, Health & Vitality, Mindset & Mental Health, Relationships, Skills & Mastery, Creativity, Productivity & Habits, Digital Life, and related foundational spheres
Curated Move inspirations tailored to each specific dimension
Reflection prompts and self-assessment milestones per dimension
Visual visualizer showing balanced growth across dimensions

future.name: Future
future.purpose: Long-term vision architecture helping users clarify where they want to go and who they strive to become.
implementedFeatures: 5-Year Vision articulation and structured milestone planning
Becoming statement definition linking current identity to aspirational identity
Constraint mapping identifying real-world friction (time, resources, obligations)
'What If?' Scenario Simulator analyzing trade-offs, required skills, upside, and immediate first moves for hypothetical life choices

navigator.name: Navigator
navigator.purpose: Built-in intelligent guidance system assisting with app discovery, problem-solving, education, coding, and strategic planning.
implementedFeatures: Interactive AI guidance grounded in CRESCIVE's philosophy (LEARN → GROW → CREATE → PROGRESS)
App-aware navigation routing users to relevant sections, games, or categories
Step-by-step educational explanations in STEM, coding, mathematics, and writing
Multimodal screenshot and image analysis assistance
Intelligent contextual fallback ensuring guidance remains available even during network disruptions

chat.name: Chat
chat.purpose: Real-time social connection and mutual accountability for verified CRESCIVE members.
implementedFeatures: Authoritative Firebase UID identity (strictly real users, zero mock accounts)
Seamless synchronization with the CRESCIVE Profile (profile picture and preferred name)
Real registered member directory with live Firestore listener and search
Real-time member presence indicator (Online Now / Active Member)
Architectural foundation for direct 1-to-1 conversations and growth circles
Strict Firestore security rules enforcing owner-only writes and authenticated-only reads

profile.name: Profile
profile.purpose: Personal user hub displaying identity, statistics, earned achievements, settings, and privacy controls.
implementedFeatures: Customizable preferred name and profile photo (upload or drag-and-drop)
Becoming statement and 5-year trajectory summary
Momentum statistics: Total XP, level, active streak, completed Moves count
Earned badges and achievement unlocks
Notification settings: chimes audio, device vibration, and timing triggers
Deep Work Sanctuary focus session logs and stats
Privacy, Permissions & Legal disclosure card with local-first data backup and export

socialSystem.overview: CRESCIVE Chat provides a social communication layer specifically designed around growth, accountability, and member discovery.
principles: Real users only: Authentication backed by authoritative Firebase UIDs; zero synthetic or mock accounts.
Unified identity: Automatically utilizes the user's existing CRESCIVE preferred name and profile picture.
Privacy-first: Public discovery displays member aspiration ('becoming') and online state; private messages are strictly access-controlled.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: What is CRESCIVE?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: CRESCIVE is an integrated personal growth system and progress platform created by Brian Omuse. It combines daily micro-actions (Moves), 15 life dimensions, future vision planning, intelligent navigation, focus flow tools, and social chat to guide users from identity to trajectory.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: Who created CRESCIVE?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: CRESCIVE was created, developed, and founded by Brian Omuse, a teenage creator and digital innovator from Malaba, Kenya.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: What is CRESCIVE's core philosophy?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: CRESCIVE operates on the philosophy: LEARN → GROW → CREATE → PROGRESS. It is founded on the idea that small, consistent daily actions compound into habits, progress, and lasting personal becoming.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: What are Moves in CRESCIVE?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: Moves are small, discrete actions that help users grow. Users select or create a Move, assign a time commitment (5 to 120 minutes) and domain, schedule reminders, and complete it to earn XP and build momentum.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: What is the 15 Map in CRESCIVE?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: The 15 Map is a holistic developmental framework organizing personal growth across 15 balanced life domains (such as Physical Health, Mindset, Skills & Mastery, Creativity, Career, and Relationships) to prevent one-sided burnout.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: Does CRESCIVE have social or chat features?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: Yes. CRESCIVE contains a dedicated Chat section backed by real Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore, enabling verified members to discover fellow learners, view profiles, and connect for growth accountability.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: Does CRESCIVE have mini-games?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: Yes. The Fun Zone features interactive 3D games (Cosmic Orbit, Precision Tap) and mental agility games (Memory Match, Reaction Speed Test, Quick Math Sprint, Word Scramble) alongside clean jokes and riddles to provide productive recharge breaks.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: Does CRESCIVE track progress and have leaderboards?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: Yes. CRESCIVE includes an XP system, daily streaks, achievement badges, and a verified community leaderboard where members can compare consistency and progress.

frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.question: What makes CRESCIVE different from a basic habit tracker?
frequentlyAnsweredQuestions.answer: CRESCIVE connects daily micro-habits to a person's deep values, 5-year vision, 15 life dimensions, deep work focus sanctuary, intelligent navigation, and real social accountability, rather than just offering a generic checklist.
